children: SPARTA COMMERCIAL SERVICES, INC. reported first-quarter 2027 results (three months ended July 31, 2026) with revenue of $47.7K, down from $96.7K a year earlier, and a net loss attributable to common stockholders of $499.5K. Diluted loss per share was $(0.01), unchanged from the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue: $47.7K for Q1 2027, compared with $96.7K in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (51%).
Net income: Net loss attributable to common stockholders $499.5K for Q1 2027, versus net loss $482.3K in the year‑ago quarter.
Diluted EPS: Loss per share $(0.01) for Q1 2027, unchanged from $(0.01) in the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue decline was driven mainly by lower merchant financing fees.
Company continues a channel shift toward B2C e-commerce (NewWorldHealthBrands) and B2B fintech (Agoge), including staged financing for Brazilian importers.
Product development: SpartaPayIQ payment gateway is completed; Sparta Crypto platform is scheduled for launch in 2026, pending execution.
Ongoing services include mobile apps, vehicle history reports (Cyclechex/RVchex/Truckchex), and custom CRM/kitchen ordering solutions.
Management is pursuing external financing to scale operations and may increase staff if the business plan is implemented.
